inspectionScope: Read-only targeted inspection of existing public batch docs, collectors, manifests, importer and current JSON. No network requests or new score collection.
sampleLimits: These are observed examples, not an exhaustive school-to-family inventory or a measured percentage of all schools that each adapter can collect.

snapshot.majorAuditClassificationRule: auditKind == major-scores OR id starts review-major-gap- OR review-major-collected-
